stem:
Bill is arranging squares in the following way:

[Image: Figure 1 with one column of two squares, Figure 2 with two columns of two squares for each column, and Figure 3 with three columns of two squares for each column.]

B. How many squares would Bill need to make Figure 16?

Answer: ____

descriptors: Incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: Three figures made of identical square tiles arranged in a grid: Figure 1 consists of 1 column of 2 squares stacked vertically, labeled "Figure 1". Figure 2 consists of 2 columns of 2 squares each (a 2-by-2 square), labeled "Figure 2". Figure 3 consists of 3 columns of 2 squares each (a 3-by-2 rectangle), labeled "Figure 3".
